entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello? Yes, I... I need some help. I think I need to return something. I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I start with your name and the order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... um... V-F-7-7-2-0-1-9. I ordered a helmet.

Thank you, Maria. I have your order right here. I see the VeloFit Aero helmet was delivered about six weeks ago. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, I'm not sure. I just... I think I chose the wrong color. My husband saw it and said it was all wrong for my bike. He thinks the dark gray isn't good for safety, you know, for being seen on the road. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out. I just feel so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Maria, there's no need to worry. I can absolutely help you with this. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for you.

Okay, I've confirmed it. You received the helmet 42 days ago. According to our policy, you have 10 days to make a return, so you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. Since the box is unopened, that makes it very straightforward.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I was stuck with it. So I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. I'm processing the return authorization now and I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
That is such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
